verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are only indirectly possible. The scriptable ykman CLI can be looped over slots, OATH entries and devices, and the YubiEnterprise REST API offers a programmatic surface for fleet delivery, inventory and shipment management. Neither is documented as a native bulk or batch feature, and users report having to replace keys account by account. Missing for 10: a documented native bulk/batch operation across many keys or credentials, bulk credential replacement or revocation, and hands-on corroboration of fleet-scale bulk actions via the API.
